---
title: "F200 Space Exploration worker-speed cap-ten fixture"
---

This disposable fixture prepares one deliberately reduced Factorio 2.0.77 / Space Exploration 0.7.57 / published MIR 5.0.15 worker-speed cap boundary. It is not Gamer433's original save or an ore-mining/productivity reproduction.

The source `0.1.0` role is create-only and requires cap zero. It uses only scripted setup to seed the actual `worker-robots-speed-6` technology at level ten with 27% current work and a repeated queued next occurrence. It also seeds a foreign-disabled level-eleven force with an unrelated 42% queue sentinel and a separate earned-above-cap level-eleven force. It creates no lab, consumes no science and receives no actor tick. Its one source marker is an `on_init` scripted-setup snapshot, not a completion or save claim.

The cap `0.2.0` role sets only `mir-max-level-worker-robots-speed` to ten. After MIR configuration has removed the disallowed queued next occurrence, it records the actual three-force `pre_work` frame before it creates the fixture lab or feeds science. It adds a fixture-only fast lab and explicitly feeds the target technology's actual current ingredient/count contract. The fixture never writes the target technology's cost, ingredients or effects. One ordinary native completion may occur; the following level-eleven state must be disabled without a second start or debit, while the earned worker-speed bonus remains. The lab is kept enabled through a two-tick post-completion hold: the input and scripted-feed totals must remain equal between the first settled completion observation and the hold end, and a bounded attempt to queue disabled level eleven must leave the queue unchanged. Only then does it save `mir5-worker-speed-cap-ten-complete`; two later cold loads only read, validate and emit one `[MIR_WORKER_SPEED_CAP_TEN phase=cold]` snapshot each.

Each marker has one JSON body with the exact active `mods` tuple/count, cap, actual per-level worker-speed effect, full player/foreign/earned force frames, and scripted setup/feed labels. The completion and cold bodies also retain the post-reconcile/pre-feed `pre_work` frame, the one `{name, by_script, tick}` ordinary event, the two-tick hold, disabled-level-eleven queue-attempt result, and lab input/feed totals. Thus the source, pre-work and final player queues are independently observable as two occurrences, one retained current occurrence and zero occurrences. The custom lab and its science input are scripted test apparatus, not physical science production evidence. A governed owner must bind the exact package/archive closure and independently review any resulting native output.
